title: SIDESTORY: ADVENTURE THAT CANNOT WAIT FOR THE SUN RERUN OPEN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: ADVENTURE THAT CANNOT WAIT FOR THE SUN RERUN
DURATION: January 6, 2026, 04:00 - January 20, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, Gemstone Engravings, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Citizen's Garden] & [Harvest Gathering]& [Treasure House]
DURATION: January 6, 2026, 04:00 - January 16, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Gemstone Engravings]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Gemstone Engravings] courses to gain rewards.
REWARDS: Ha'maimenat Garden (Pieces), Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
[Event Guidebook]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Event Guidebook] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Papyrus], Ha'maimenat Garden (Pieces), Flowing Glimmerdust, Module Materials, etc.
[Grand Bazaar]
DURATION: January 6, 2026, 04:00 - January 16, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Flowing Glimmerdust by clearing event stages and completing [Grand Bazaar] missions. Flowing Glimmerdust can be used to redeem items from [Grand Bazaar]. REWARDS: Papyrus's Token, Ha'maimenat Garden (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
Note:

- For this rerun event, some of the engraved medals in the corresponding Engraved Medal Set will have their acquisition conditions adjusted. Players who meet the updated conditions will be able to obtain the event's engraved medals. Due to these adjustments, players who previously participated in the event and already meet the new acquisition conditions will receive the corresponding engraved medals immediately upon the update.
- After this rerun event ends, the engraved medals from the event's Engraved Medal Set cannot be obtained again through [Score] or any other channels.
- This rerun event is a lightweight rerun; event stages will inherit the player's previous event stage progress and first-time drop progress.

- Some non-repeatable event rewards during this rerun can be converted into [Intelligence Certificate] at a corresponding ratio when obtained again. The conversion rates can be found in the event's Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules.
- The [Intelligence Certificate] shop will restock additional quantities of existing items and add new items when the event starts.
- Trust gain for Pepe, Narantuya, Sand Reckoner, and Papyrus will be increased in the event stages of this rerun.
- After this event ends, the event stages will be permanently added to [Score] on January 20, 2026, at 04:00 (UTC-7).
